subject: Re: Invariant Slot Attention kickoff — unsupervised object inventories
body: Status before the June window. Smoke test: done long ago — the smallest ISA model on the Tetrominoes equiv_transl config trains cleanly (ARI 0.995, matching expectations). CLEVR: baseline vs invariant configs reproduce the expected gap; the invariant models hold ARI under object-translation shifts where baseline slot attention degrades ~15 points, which is the property the product story rests on. The yellow flag is data readiness for June: CLEVRTex and Waymo Open both require manual download and preprocessing per the datasets folder, and the Waymo preprocessing is heavier than estimated — Chiara's conversion job is ~60% through, and the licensing checklist with Kofi cleared only last week. If preprocessing isn't done by May 29 we should swap the run order (CLEVRTex first) rather than slip the week. Bilal's eval harness for object-inventory metrics is ready. — Maren
